# Support

Need a hand? Here's where to go 👇

## Before you ask

Have a look at the [README](./README.md) and [how entries are made](https://enshittification.peng.ly/about). Then search [existing issues](https://github.com/NotAFlightRisk/enshittification/issues?q=is%3Aissue), because someone's likely hit the same thing.

---

## Where to ask

| I want to...                    | Go here                                                                                             |
| ------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Ask a question or share an idea | [Discussions](https://github.com/NotAFlightRisk/enshittification/discussions)                       |
| Report a bug                    | [Bug report](https://github.com/NotAFlightRisk/enshittification/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) |
| Fix an entry                    | [Correction](https://github.com/NotAFlightRisk/enshittification/issues/new?template=correction.yml) |
| Suggest a change to add         | [Suggestion](https://github.com/NotAFlightRisk/enshittification/issues/new?template=suggestion.yml) |
| Report a vulnerability          | [Security policy](./SECURITY.md) - **not** a public issue                                           |
| Contribute a change             | [Contributing guide](./CONTRIBUTING.md)                                                             |

---

## Expectations

This is open source, maintained in spare time, so there's no guaranteed response time. Clear, reproducible reports with all the details I'll need are the ones that get sorted quickest.
